name: External Enquiry Request Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external request type code for the enquiry on a position in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code set published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

RT11.name: Bank Position Enquiry
RT11.definition: Type is an enquiry on the bank's position.

RT12.name: Specific Transaction Enquiry
RT12.definition: Type is an enquiry on a specific transaction.

RT13.name: Queued Transaction Enquiry
RT13.definition: Type is an enquiry on a queued transaction.

RT14.name: Suspicious Transaction Enquiry
RT14.definition: Type is an enquiry on a suspicious transaction.

RT16.name: Sytem Time Enquiry
RT16.definition: Type is an enquiry on the system date and/or time.

RT15.name: Pending Inward Credits Enquiry
RT15.definition: Type is an enquiry on pending inward credits.
